Iris (Content): Quick note 15m interview with Stonebridge Health done. Raw & rough cuts in Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/stonebridge. Marked hero clip 00:40-01:30 and a technical snippet 03:10-03:50. Need a short hero quote, legal ok, and CRM routing before we lock publish + webinar CTA.

Ben (PMM): Nice. Paste the hero one-liner you want and target publish window.

Iris (Content): Draft hero: "Redwood helped us reduce inference costs and accelerate our delivery cadence." Target publish: 2026-11-16. Also they offered a before/after chart but asked we not show raw numbers.

Maya (AE): Stonebridge requests inbound leads from the case CTA go to their CS-Ops queue first, then fall back to our enterprise SDRs after 36h. They want campaign=stonebridge_launch_q4 and token=stonebridge_tok_1126.

routing-bot: To add routing provide comma-separated key=value pairs. Example: lead_source=case_study,owner=team-x.

Maya (AE): Use payload: lead_source=stonebridge_case,owner=stonebridge-cs-ops,fallback_owner=redwood-enterprise-sdr,followup_delay=36h,campaign=stonebridge_launch_q4,token=stonebridge_tok_1126

Oliver (Legal): I skimmed the transcript. Two redlines: 1) they quoted a specific percentage decrease in cost 23%  we need that removed unless Stonebridge confirms in writing; replace with "meaningful cost reductions". 2) remove a one-off vendor mention. Send updated hero/bench copy and I'll sign off.

Iris (Content): Edited hero per legal: "Redwood helped us achieve meaningful cost reductions and accelerate our delivery cadence across teams." Removed vendor reference.

Ben (PMM): That reads well. For the landing deck I'll use: "How Stonebridge scaled inference, lowered unit costs, and sped releases without rearchitecting services." Also planning a joint webinar ~2 weeks after publish; tentative date 2026-11-30.

Oliver (Legal): Approving the edited hero and deck phrasing. Oliver (Legal) :white_check_mark: Please ensure the chart is schematic with labelled axes and no numeric ticks.

Tess (Producer): Got it. I'll create a 60s hero cut and a 30s social teaser. Uploading assets to Drive now. Iris, can you confirm attribution line and a short byline for the case page?

Iris (Content): Attribution: "Paula Ortiz, Head of ML, Stonebridge Health". Byline: "Leads ML platform and production inference at Stonebridge."

Maya (AE): Confirming the CRM payload above. Also Stonebridge asked ticket_subject=Stonebridge case - demo request. Can we wire that?

routing-bot: Routing rule queued to staging with ticket_subject=Stonebridge case - demo request. Reminder: deploy to production 60 minutes before publish window.

Ben (PMM): I'll add the webinar to the launch checklist, draft co-presenter bullets, and create the registration template. Tess, please add speaker bullets and request headshot + signed quote consent from Paula.

Tess (Producer): On it. Requesting headshot and signed consent now. Also planning an animated schematic for the bench chart (no numbers).

Oliver (Legal): Once the landing draft includes the edited quote and schematic, @Oliver will do a final quick pass. Approved for publish prep.

Iris (Content): Thanks team. Final checklist: legal approved quote, routing staged with token & ticket subject, assets uploading to Drive, webinar tentatively 11/30. I'll push the final landing copy by EOD tomorrow and tag for final sign-off. :rocket:
